==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Woodrow:''' The storm formed by the abnormal gravity field seems to be returning...
:'''Woodrow:''' So a new story is about to begin?
:{{DIcon}} So the storm is happening again?
:{{DIcon}} A new story?
:'''Woodrow:''' Oh, actually... It's not that much of a big deal.
:'''Woodrow:''' I've been conducting uninterrupted observations at this weather Observation Station...
:'''Woodrow:''' Recent observation data shows that the weather changes in the surroundings share similarities with the storms happening here in the past...
:'''Woodrow:''' But the similarity are still in the cradle. I can't jump to conclusions now.
:'''Woodrow:''' Don't worry. I'll keep an eye on this.
:'''Woodrow:''' That's right. The hero embarks on a journey in the vast wilderness, battling against the harsh natural environment and engaging in thrilling fights with bounty criminals...
:'''Woodrow:''' I'm captivated by such a fearless and firm belief.
:'''Woodrow:''' If you're into Westerns too, I'd be more than happy to share my long-cherished movie list with you!
{{Dialogue End}}
